text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said Friday it had signed a series of long-term agreements to market human pharmaceuticals with Merck & Co Inc in Israel through a new organization, Merck Sharp & Dohme (Israel- 1996) Co Ltd.

Teva said it will manufacture MSD products that will be marketed by MSD-Israel. Teva subsidiary Salomon Levin and Elstein Ltd will provide distribution services for all MSD human pharmaceutical products in Israel.
Previously, MSD products were marketed in Israel by Assia-Riesel LP, a partnership between Teva and S. Riesel Chemical Products Ltd.
As of the effective date of the agreements, anticipated by the parties to be July 1, Assia-Riesel will cease marketing MSD human health prescription products.
